objective: Port everything back to our game from the decomp

verified.numeric_primitives: Signed 16.16 multiply/divide and two uint32 RNG recurrences match 317 native executable cases. Fixed arithmetic is not yet connected to movement.
verified.runtime_ammo_primitives: Addition (004C2FB0), spending (004C3010) and the ordinary-weapon availability path (004C2EE0) match 120 original-x86 cases executed in Unicorn 2.1.4. Addition and spending are integrated across weapon and utility actions and crate pickups. Negative/unlimited stock survives use; arbitrary 3/9-item caps are removed. Weapon delays are now connected through the browser turn adapter; special availability rules remain unported.
verified.delay_countdown: Counter block 004E71BE and countdown 004E6630 match 16 original-x86 cases, covering two banks, first/subsequent turns, bypass, signed overflow, negative delays and reserved slot zero. Numerical fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/delays.json.
verified.sprite_resource_ids: Extracted all 767 descriptors from executable resource table 00564A78, passed to the sprite loader at 004CBB50. Descriptor fields are ID, filename pointer and flags; terminated at 00566E6C. Every referenced sprite exists in imported assets. Reproducible with tools/armageddon/sprite-table.py; result src/armageddon/sprite-ids.json.
verified.freeze_dispatch_and_animation: Original x86 block 004FCF8B sends event 0x411 with the user team ID in all six tested teams. Original 004F5C80 queues [0x242,0x248] after animation 0x23F, otherwise clears and queues [0x23C,0x248]. Five input animations verified in Unicorn. IDs resolve to wicelk2/wicestnd and wicelk3/wicestnd. Fixture tests/fixtures/armageddon/freeze.json. Sound descriptor IDs 0x18/0x19/0x6A resolve to freeze.wav/unfreeze.wav/frozenwormimpact.wav.
verified.animation_player: Original x86 sampler 004B0260, metadata 004AFC10 and queue routines 004FD270/2B0/3B0/4B0 match 224 frame samples, 15 real sprite metadata records, eight 120-tick queue traces and 42 queue API operations. Native 0x51E tick delta, fixed-point rates, loop/ping-pong flags, queue capacity and controlled progress are integrated. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/animation.json.
verified.weapon_animation_selector: 004FA490 matches all 71 weapon records captured from the original initializer under controlled inputs. Eleven browser weapons now select the corresponding native sprite, including throw, mine/dynamite, airstrike and bat poses. This does not establish native scheme defaults or full weapon behavior.
verified.weapon_equip: 004F61E0 equip transition matches 1,533 original-x86 cases across all 71 controlled-input weapon records, three previous states, seven angles and three rope modes. Covers link queues, clear/preserve behavior, initial strip progress, control mode, signed quantization and weapon limits. Animation interface calls are observed; only rope-mode lookup is supplied. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/equip.json.
verified.weapon_post_fire: Original 004F6DA0 queue/delay outputs match 355 original-x86 cases across all 71 controlled-input weapon records and five progress values. Recoil tick 004F6FA0 matches 1,704 cases covering signed countdowns, animation completion gating and resume states 0x65/0x6B. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/recoil.json.
verified.weapon_preparation: Original preparation entry 004F67E0 and tick 004F6B20 match 480 entry cases and 3,195 tick cases across all 71 controlled-input weapon records. Captures animation calls, signed countdown, burst field, cue flag, sound IDs, release call and transition target. RNG input and voice lookup are supplied; audio/launch interfaces are observed and projectile payload construction is stubbed. Native sound descriptor 0055F2F0 maps 0x51 to ShotgunReload.wav. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/preparation.json. Original worm dispatcher 004DDBD0 advances animator at 004DE2BA before dispatching state 0x69 to preparation tick.
verified.trigonometry: 0049BFB0/0049BFF0 port uses the original 1,281 signed table entries at 005603A0 and 6-bit linear interpolation. SHA-256 of every sine/cosine output for all 65,536 input words matches original x86. Negative/overflow word wrapping also checked. Production table src/armageddon/trig-table.json; exhaustive digest in tests/fixtures/armageddon/launch.json.
verified.launch_geometry: 004FAF90 matches 1,056 original-x86 cases over all 71 controlled-input weapon records. Covers facing, angle, preview RNG suppression, non-preview RNG consumption, signed spread arithmetic, action-specific muzzle offsets, action-9 terrain scans, dropped-item directions, airstrike target and utility directions. Position/collision/RNG interfaces supplied explicitly. Native projectile construction and speed remain outside this routine.
verified.charge_and_launch_velocity: Original 004F67A0 matches 45 type/power cases including signed overflow and transition threshold. Original velocity block 004FA840..004FAA11 matches 2,840 cases across all 71 controlled-input weapon records, five powers, four direction vectors and two worm states. Covers fixed 24x/20x paths, charged fixedMultiply-then-24x paths, direction-only weapons and inherited vertical velocity for type 2/state 0x79. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/power.json.
verified.air_forces_and_pixel_sweep: Original airborne forces 004CA110 and collision sweep 004C9AA0 match 432 cases each. Sweeps verify exact fixed-point contact positions, contact side, remaining tick fraction, collision ID and query order across positive/negative axes, zero/partial/full movement and six collision predicates. Forces verify gravity, wind, drag, zero-gravity early return and stationary support checks. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/motion.json. 004C9AA0 consumes velocity directly over a normalized 0x10000 tick fraction; native velocity units are position units per simulation tick.
verified.simple_body_bounce: Original 004F4860 simple-body branch (body+0x4c == 0) matches 960 executable cases. Covers all four contact sides, ignored sides, independent horizontal/vertical restitution and tangential drag, and signed Manhattan-speed cutoff 0x6666 on both bodies, including exact boundary and overflow cases. Complex terrain response is verified separately below. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/motion.json.
verified.water_motion: Original 004C9F10 matches 224 executable cases over body flag 0x400000, integer water-height boundary, skim suppression, horizontal/vertical speed thresholds and clear/blocked surface queries. Verifies skim velocity reflection, 0xcccc horizontal damping, virtual +0x40 skim event, submerged flag, water drag and downward acceleration 0x4ccc. This routine is water response, not terrain contact friction. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/motion.json.
verified.simple_body_tick: Original 004CA320 simple-body path matches 192 complete state/callback/query traces with earthquake disabled and collision-mask cache primed to the supplied predicate. Covers periodic wake checks, sleeping/awake bodies, water-before-air-force ordering, submerged events, up to two collision responses using remaining tick fraction, radius-derived angular velocity, signed angle accumulation, +/-32 pixel/tick velocity clamp and support/sleep updates. Native collision callback, awake predicate and event sinks are explicit; bounce callback executes original 004F4860. Complex-body path and earthquake impulses remain unported. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/motion.json.
verified.projectile_body_configuration: 004E1830 numeric setup block 004E1ACB..004E1CD0 matches 432 original executable cases over six modes, signed launch velocities, repeat flag, four scheme friction bytes and three coefficient profiles including signed-shift overflow. Verifies mass, collision flags, mode-specific restitution, nested integer percentage rounding, drag/wind/gravity scales, repeated mode-4 position/velocity changes and accepted placement state. Terrain and manager callbacks are stubbed; blocked placement, record selection, allocation and other constructor effects remain outside scope. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/projectile-body.json.
verified.projectile_selection: 004E1908..004E1A18 matches 355 executable cases across 71 controlled-input records and five repeat indices. Preserves 42 selected words, signed secondary sprite remainder, primary sound request, owner event/flag, timer fallback and mode-2 bounce fallback. Secondary sprite count explicitly set to 3 to exercise all records; these are not standard-match defaults. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/projectile-selection.json.
verified.embedded_scheme_resources: Extracted 18 SCHEMES resources directly from the verified executable using PE resource directories and RVA-to-section mapping. Each has SCHM/version-1 header and 216-byte payload, matching loader 00470A20 (copies 0x36 words after five-byte header) and disk reader 00470740. Numeric payloads: src/armageddon/scheme-data.json; reproducible extractor: tools/armageddon/scheme-resources.py. This proves shipped resource contents, not yet the mapping from each payload to live context offsets.
verified.scheme_runtime_expansion: Located frontend builder 00415540. Scheme object at 006F454C stores its 216-byte primary payload at 006F4560; 00470700 copies it to the backup slot before expansion. Executed 00415540..004175EA for all 18 shipped resources, bypassing team setup 00419150, starting-team selection 00419840 and inventory setup 00417750. Clock/CRT seeding return zero; handicap getter inputs are zero. Captured builder offsets d430..d60f only. Runtime context mapping is builder offset -0x3c +0x47a8, from the 0x3719-word copy in 004A5350. This gives context+0x11b9c for captured data, including friction 96 at +0x11ba0 in every shipped preset. Artifact: src/armageddon/scheme-runtime-data.json. Team inventory, randomness, handicap and full match creation remain outside this capture.
verified.scheme_weapon_records: Executed original initializer 004B90A0 for each of the 18 expanded schemes, capturing all 71 weapon records (1,278 total), numeric fields +0x48..+0x204. The expanded settings replace previous controlled zero values and percentage-divisor substitutes. Localized names remain empty; other context is zero. Artifact: src/armageddon/scheme-weapon-data.json; reproducible builder tools/armageddon/build-scheme-weapons.py. These are preset-driven initializer outputs, not team inventories or later match-specific overrides. Resource 195 confirms rocket wind scale 100%, grenade wind scale 0%, gravity scale 100%, grenade payload-supplied bounce and 96% scheme friction.
verified.live_projectile_adapter: Direct regression tests verify 24 pixels/tick full launch, zero-power launch, native 0x3d70 gravity, rocket versus grenade wind coefficients, 55% payload bounce and 96% friction, continued movement after a one-pixel wall bounce, and native shallow-angle water response. Full existing suite: 262 passed, 2 skipped, with two duplicate AI angle-jitter boundary failures corrected to assert the actual 5-degree clamp; targeted AI and new adapter suite then passed all 24 tests. Production build passed. Tests establish the browser adapter contract, not full native game equivalence.
verified.body_awake: Original projectile vtable +0xf4 resolves to 004D11E0. All 32 combinations of nonzero vx, vy, submerged, contact and moving flags match executable returns. This predicate is now used by the live native-body adapter, enabling the original 13-tick periodic wake/surface recheck. Regression checks sleeping on support and falling after support is removed. Full gameplay suite yielded 274 passes and two platform skips; the two duplicate new water-test failures assumed entry before the integer boundary. After correcting that expectation, all 24 native motion/adapter checks passed. Build passed.
verified.water_sound_callbacks: 004E2220, 004F4FE0, 004F4FC0 and real queue 004EDC90 match 108 executable cases across velocities, signed overflow, splash suppression and queue counts 0/15/16. Static descriptors 0055F258/0055F260 map IDs 57/58 to Splash.wav/Splish.wav. Fixture tests preserve all five request words and suppression reset. Live native body water/skimming callbacks now collect requests; main audio routes them to original samples. Browser tests verify both files decode and gain mapping; 20 asset/runtime/callback checks plus four focused audio checks passed. Build passed.
verified.two_body_collision: 004F4990 matches 432 original executable cases with no stubbed callbacks. Covers four contact sides and ignored sides, unequal/signed masses, axis momentum exchange, tangential damping and cutoff before same-direction early return, normal impulse halving above threshold, signed fixed division and final Manhattan-speed stops on both bodies. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/body-collision.json. Native dispatcher 004F4C30 first invokes contacted body virtual +0x28 and invokes incoming body +0x24 only if the first callback returns zero.
verified.worm_projectile_collision_gate: Original worm callback 004D6AD0 matches 200 executable cases for ordinary projectile type 0x0f, state range 0x60..0x8f plus signed/out-of-range sentinels and all four sides. State/position/type getters are supplied; the original 004F4990 runs normally. Only state 0x79 or 0x7e..0x81 invokes momentum exchange; other states decline, allowing incoming-body fallback dispatch. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/body-collision.json. Worm constructor 004D5A40 inherits base mass 0x10000 and scheme tangential coefficient from 004F4000; special incoming worm/rope branches remain unported.
verified.complex_terrain_bounce: Original 004F4700 and its enclosing 004F4860 branch match 900 executable cases. Covers leading-edge upper/lower collision probes, short-circuit ordering, signed coordinate wrap, tangential multiply-by-30 overflow and division truncation, reflection, and enclosing both-body stop cutoff. Shared bounce helper dispatches on body.complex; current projectiles use complex=0. Full native worm state/body integration and constraint-body stepping remain unported. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/body-collision.json.
verified.worm_state_body_preparation: 004D7730..004D7A65 matches 4,332 original executable cases over 38 previous/next states and three input profiles. Original vtable body setters, type setter and constraint detach execute; exit routines, manager callbacks, allocator, sound backend and weapon lookup are explicit stubs. Verifies complex terrain-response toggle, enabled/suspended flags, mask restoration, wind-scale signed percentage, drag, constraint removal, body types and remaining field writes, plus external effect ordering. Native state itself is not committed in this prefix. src/armageddon/worm-state.js; fixture tests/fixtures/armageddon/worm-state.json. Live worm transitions are not yet integrated.
verified.worm_jump_landing_entry: State entries 0x79 (wflyup/wbackflp) and 0x7a (wland1/wland2 with special preceding-state/sprite links) match 480 original executable cases reached through common preparation. Tests preserve sprite/voice selection, sound replacement order and vertical-speed sound strength including signed INT_MIN behavior. Animation, voice lookup and playback are observed interface stubs; native body velocity getter runs. Scope ends at 004D8189 before transition finalization. Not yet connected to browser worm movement.

partial.simulation_clock: 50 Hz integrated. Original input queues, frame dispatch, pause handling and fast-forward remain unported.
partial.random_streams: Gameplay and cosmetic streams integrated. Original caller masks, draw order and map RNG remain unported.
partial.weapon_configuration: tools/armageddon/weapon-oracle.py executes the original 004B90A0 initializer with explicit controlled inputs and captures all 71 final records. Local output: .local-research/armageddon/oracle/weapons-zero.json. Context is zeroed except special-weapon enable and two nonzero percentage divisors; localized name getters return empty strings. This is not a standard-match profile. Field semantics, native scheme defaults and per-weapon state machines still need tracing.
partial.decompile_coverage: Initial automatic analysis missed the 6,460-byte team-event handler at 004E6810. Recovered separately in Ghidra. Its 0x41C branch calls delay countdown 004E6630 only when the counter at task+0x60 exceeds one; global inventory+0x2C10 controls counter increments and availability bypass. Event routing and counter lifecycle still need full tracing. Original 8,025 exported functions must not be treated as complete executable coverage.
partial.original_media: User explicitly requested original sprites, animations and sounds, superseding the procedural-only art preference. Imported 770 SPR animations (14,273 frames), 123 effects and 49 voice banks (2,692 samples), browsable in armageddon.html. Core worm states, eleven weapon poses, frozen entry/idle and gameplay effect mappings are integrated. Runtime uses original sprite rates and loop flags. Gallery preview remains 25 fps. Remaining transitions, utility art, HUD, sound priorities and voice triggers require wiring.
partial.weapon_delays: 11 identified weapon slots now support saved per-weapon delays, HUD lock/countdown labels, selection/firing gates and AI filtering. Browser beginTurn advances each team separately, with frozen squads thawed before play; settings reset delays per island, including stockpile rounds. Full native event scheduling remains unported; the thaw order now follows the recovered team handler. Native defaults remain unknown, so existing presets stay zero-delay. Daily islands ignore custom delays. Utility delays, original unlock notifications, full 0x41C routing and bypass lifecycle remain unported. Sticky and thrown napalm are browser variants without asserted native identities.
partial.freeze: Replaced incorrect enemy-turn skip with own-team protection and thaw at the next own turn. Static trace: team handler 004E6810 filters 0x411 by team and broadcasts 0x412 at start of 0x41C; worm handler 004D97F0 sets state 0x88, thaws to 0x65, bypasses health damage for 0x404/0x433, suppresses horizontal impulse, and excludes frozen worms from poison events 0x426/0x439. Browser damage/poison and blast/shotgun/bat gates updated; drowning remains lethal. Native entry/idle sprites integrated using original metadata rates and the verified native queue; original freeze/thaw/impact samples now play. Team activation/thaw sounds play once per team in the browser, with native per-worm priority arbitration still unported. Native collision/impulse magnitudes, poison timing, cast and thaw transitions, and sound priority remain unported. AI still uses the browser heuristic, now targets its own squad.
partial.animation_state_graph: Native player, weapon selector, equip link queues and post-fire/recoil queue/countdown integrated. Entering a weapon pose from browser locomotion/idle uses native idle-entry queues; switching directly between weapon poses skips the idle link. Mine/dynamite, projectile release, shotgun and bat actions now seed the native selected pose and post-fire queue, hold controlled firing frames, and leave on the verified zero-before-decrement countdown. This remains a browser action/state adapter: native pre-fire scheduling for weapons other than shotgun, native resume routing, sound events, slope, death lifecycle and utility transitions are unported. The pure equip function reproduces native angle/control changes, but live aim degrees and zero-rate locomotion progress remain browser-driven. Hurt, death, freeze and knockback cancel the browser recoil overlay.
partial.shotgun_preparation: Shotgun now queues native wshotp/aim sequence and advances preparation once per 50 Hz simulation tick. First release occurs after 46 ticks; original reload cue plays once. Ammo spending and hitscan damage occur only at release. Input and worm selection are locked during preparation, game pause suspends it, and hurt/death/knockback/freeze or loss of browser aim phase cancels it. The browser still controls turn expiry, repeat shots, damage/hit geometry and scheduling of action entry; complete native state/event lifecycle remains unported. Other weapons have verified preparation primitives but are not yet connected. Type-2 repeat-fire state writes after release, native sound priority and launch payload construction remain unported.
partial.launch_integration: Bazooka, homing missile, mortar, grenade, cluster and holy grenade now use nativeLaunchVelocity with original integer trig, percentage-to-fixed charge and native per-tick velocity converted at 50 Hz. Their browser speed multipliers are bypassed. Muzzle origin, input-angle quantization, spread RNG and nativeLaunch action geometry remain browser adapters. Custom sticky/napalm retain browser launch speed; dropped/secondary bodies are not connected yet.
partial.charge_integration: Human and AI charging advances signed 16.16 power by 0x369 per tick, reaching full charge on tick 76. UI power percentage feeds native launch scaling for the six mapped live projectile weapons. Browser input/release routing and custom-variant charging remain adapters.
partial.projectile_pixel_sweep: Six mapped live projectile weapons now use nativeSimpleBodyTick and its original fixed-point sweep, with up to two contacts and remaining-tick movement after bounce. Other browser projectile variants retain sweepProjectile around float integration. Collision IDs preserve contacted worm identity. Terrain and worm predicates still use browser collision geometry, not native masks.
partial.body_response_integration: Live bazooka, homing missile, mortar, grenade, cluster and holy grenade attach bodies from default native resource 195 via verified selection and constructor arithmetic. Each 50 Hz tick uses native force, sweep, simple bounce and remaining-fraction sequence. Native gravity is 0x3d70 times browser gravity modifier; browser wind acceleration is converted to native per-tick units. The AI predictor shares this adapter at 50 Hz. Projectile-body awake callback now uses original 004D11E0; contacted bodies are treated as stationary for bounce. Native masks, complex-body response, earthquake impulses, callbacks, angular rendering, homing guidance and full water lifecycle remain unported. Native projectiles now persist across water entry, allowing next-tick skimming or sinking with native water drag. Browser world-bottom y=0, 12-second cleanup and fuse termination remain adapters; original 004E44A0 uses context+0x808 as its depth cleanup boundary. AI waits for confirmed submersion before rejecting a water shot. Original splash/skim requests and samples are now connected. Browser playback converts request strength to capped linear gain with its existing master gain; native spatial mixing, priority, backend attenuation and underwater projectile state/events remain unported. The sixteen-request queue primitive is verified, but the live adapter collects water events per projectile step rather than a global native frame-wide queue. Browser impact/detonation, damage and fuse lifecycle remain active. Custom variants and secondary fragments retain previous physics.
partial.projectile_configuration_source: Static constructor tracing maps the main weapon projectile block at record+0x74 (004FCB20) to primary fields at +0x80: flags +0x80, drag +0xb0, wind +0xb4, gravity +0xbc, mode +0xdc, collision flags +0xe0, bounce +0xe4, friction +0xe8. Secondary configuration starts 0xc4 bytes later. A zero mode-2 bounce value is replaced by payload[9] before numeric setup. Existing controlled-input initializer records are not standard-match defaults; Primary/secondary selection and launch fallbacks are now executable-verified. Shipped scheme expansion and context mapping are now captured, and preset-driven weapon initializer records are available for all 18 resources. The six mapped live projectile weapons now consume default resource 195 records. Browser preset selection still needs mapping to other native scheme resources; later per-match overrides and inventories remain unported.
partial.two_body_collision_integration: nativeBodyCollision and nativeWormProjectileCollision are verified, but live contacts still use stationary-target bounce. The ordinary projectile gate is known; connecting it requires the native worm state lifecycle rather than guessing from browser ground/knocked flags. Native masks and incoming projectile special modes/detonation dispatch in 004E2240 remain unported. Special worm/rope contact branches in 004D6AD0 and non-worm receivers remain incomplete.
